services.desc: The Folsom Concert Association is proud to announce its 2026 - 2027 season! This season brings an energetic lineup of music to the greater Folsom area and beyond, celebrating iconic songs, powerhouse performers, and unforgettable live entertainment. Enjoy five shows featuring acclaimed touring artists and celebrated tribute acts. The shows will be held between September 2026 and April 2027 on Sundays at 2 PM. The Folsom Concert Association is one of the most reasonably priced concert series in our region! Get a Season Subscription to guarantee your seats and five shows for the price of four! Pricing ranges from $180 to $255 for the entire season. That means each show is $36 to $51,
